description: Get facts of Azure Key Vault key.

parameters.name: ad_user
parameters.description: Active Directory username. Use when authenticating with an Active Directory user rather than service principal.

parameters.name: adfs_authority_url
parameters.description: Azure AD authority url. Use when authenticating with Username/password, and has your own ADFS authority.

parameters.name: api_profile
parameters.description: Selects an API profile to use when communicating with Azure services. Default value of latest is appropriate for public clouds; future values will allow use with Azure Stack. Default: "latest"

parameters.name: auth_source
parameters.description: Controls the source of the credentials to use for authentication. Can also be set via the ANSIBLE_AZURE_AUTH_SOURCE environment variable. When set to auto (the default) the precedence is module parameters -> env -> credential_file -> cli. When set to env, the credentials will be read from the environment variables When set to credential_file, it will read the profile from ~/.azure/credentials. When set to cli, the credentials will be sources from the Azure CLI profile. subscription_id or the environment variable AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION_ID can be used to identify the subscription ID if more than one is present otherwise the default az cli subscription is used. When set to msi, the host machine must be an azure resource with an enabled MSI extension. subscription_id or the environment variable AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION_ID can be used to identify the subscription ID if the resource is granted access to more than one subscription, otherwise the first subscription is chosen. The msi was added in Ansible 2.6. Choices: "auto" ← (default) "cli" "credential_file" "env" "msi"

parameters.name: cert_validation_mode
parameters.description: Controls the certificate validation behavior for Azure endpoints. By default, all modules will validate the server certificate, but when an HTTPS proxy is in use, or against Azure Stack, it may be necessary to disable this behavior by passing ignore. Can also be set via credential file profile or the AZURE_CERT_VALIDATION environment variable. Choices: "ignore" "validate"

parameters.name: client_id
parameters.description: Azure client ID. Use when authenticating with a Service Principal or Managed Identity (msi). Can also be set via the AZURE_CLIENT_ID environment variable.

parameters.name: cloud_environment
parameters.description: For cloud environments other than the US public cloud, the environment name (as defined by Azure Python SDK, eg, AzureChinaCloud, AzureUSGovernment), or a metadata discovery endpoint URL (required for Azure Stack). Can also be set via credential file profile or the AZURE_CLOUD_ENVIRONMENT environment variable. Default: "AzureCloud"

parameters.name: disable_instance_discovery
parameters.description: Determines whether or not instance discovery is performed when attempting to authenticate. Setting this to true will completely disable both instance discovery and authority validation. This functionality is intended for use in scenarios where the metadata endpoint cannot be reached such as in private clouds or Azure Stack. The process of instance discovery entails retrieving authority metadata from https://login.microsoft.com/ to validate the authority. By setting this to **True**, the validation of the authority is disabled. As a result, it is crucial to ensure that the configured authority host is valid and trustworthy. Set via credential file profile or the AZURE_DISABLE_INSTANCE_DISCOVERY environment variable. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: log_mode
parameters.description: Parent argument.

parameters.name: log_path
parameters.description: Parent argument.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Key name. If not set, will list all keys in vault_uri.

parameters.name: password
parameters.description: Active Directory user password. Use when authenticating with an Active Directory user rather than service principal.

parameters.name: profile
parameters.description: Security profile found in ~/.azure/credentials file.

parameters.name: secret
parameters.description: Azure client secret. Use when authenticating with a Service Principal.

parameters.name: show_deleted_key
parameters.description: Set to true to show deleted keys. Set to false to show not deleted keys. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: subscription_id
parameters.description: Your Azure subscription Id.

parameters.name: tags
parameters.description: Limit results by providing a list of tags. Format tags as ‘key’ or ‘key:value’.

parameters.name: tenant
parameters.description: Azure tenant ID. Use when authenticating with a Service Principal.

parameters.name: thumbprint
parameters.description: The thumbprint of the private key specified in x509_certificate_path. Use when authenticating with a Service Principal. Required if x509_certificate_path is defined.

parameters.name: vault_uri
parameters.description: Vault uri where the key stored in.

parameters.name: version
parameters.description: Key version. Set it to current to show latest version of a key. Set it to all to list all versions of a key. Set it to specific version to list specific version of a key. eg. fd2682392a504455b79c90dd04a1bf46. Default: "current"

parameters.name: x509_certificate_path
parameters.description: Path to the X509 certificate used to create the service principal in PEM format. The certificate must be appended to the private key. Use when authenticating with a Service Principal.

examples:
- name: Get latest version of specific key
  azure_rm_keyvaultkey_info:
    vault_uri: "https://myVault.vault.azure.net"
    name: myKey

- name: List all versions of specific key
  azure_rm_keyvaultkey_info:
    vault_uri: "https://myVault.vault.azure.net"
    name: myKey
    version: all

- name: List specific version of specific key
  azure_rm_keyvaultkey_info:
    vault_uri: "https://myVault.vault.azure.net"
    name: myKey
    version: fd2682392a504455b79c90dd04a1bf46

- name: List all keys in specific key vault
  azure_rm_keyvaultkey_info:
    vault_uri: "https://myVault.vault.azure.net"

- name: List deleted keys in specific key vault
  azure_rm_keyvaultkey_info:
    vault_uri: "https://myVault.vault.azure.net"
    show_deleted_key: true

return_values.name: keyvaults
return_values.description: List of keys in Azure Key Vault. Returned: always

return_values.name: attributes
return_values.description: Key attributes. Returned: success

return_values.name: created
return_values.description: Creation datetime. Returned: always Sample: "2019-04-25T07:26:49+00:00"

return_values.name: enabled
return_values.description: Indicate whether the key is enabled. Returned: always Sample: "True"

return_values.name: expires
return_values.description: Expiration datetime. Returned: success Sample: "2019-04-25T07:26:49+00:00"

return_values.name: not_before
return_values.description: Not before datetime. Returned: success Sample: "2019-04-25T07:26:49+00:00"

return_values.name: recovery_level
return_values.description: Reflects the deletion recovery level currently in effect for keys in the current vault. If it contains Purgeable the key can be permanently deleted by a privileged user. Otherwise, only the system can purge the key, at the end of the retention interval. Returned: always Sample: "Purgable"

return_values.name: updated
return_values.description: Update datetime. Returned: always Sample: "2019-04-25T07:26:49+00:00"

return_values.name: key
return_values.description: public part of a key. Returned: success

return_values.name: crv
return_values.description: Elliptic curve name. Returned: success

return_values.name: e
return_values.description: RSA public exponent. Returned: success

return_values.name: n
return_values.description: RSA modules. Returned: success

return_values.name: x
return_values.description: X component of an EC public key. Returned: success

return_values.name: y
return_values.description: Y component of an EC public key. Returned: success

return_values.name: kid
return_values.description: Key identifier. Returned: always Sample: "https://myVault.vault.azure.net/keys/key1/fd2682392a504455b79c90dd04a1bf46"

return_values.name: managed
return_values.description: True if the key’s lifetime is managed by key vault. Returned: success Sample: true

return_values.name: permitted_operations
return_values.description: Permitted operations on the key. Returned: always Sample: ["encrypt"]

return_values.name: tags
return_values.description: Tags of the key. Returned: always Sample: ["foo"]

return_values.name: type
return_values.description: Key type. Returned: always Sample: "RSA"

return_values.name: version
return_values.description: Key version. Returned: always Sample: "fd2682392a504455b79c90dd04a1bf46"
